title: Define 'sovereign models' and realistic AI hosting options
requirements:
- Define the sovereignty dimensions intended and avoid implying domestic hosting alone ensures control
- Name in-jurisdiction options for AI under Autonomy and Sovereignty
- Where domestic AI development is mentioned, address where the resulting capability runs and under whose control
- Present national, regional, shared, regulated commercial and hybrid options with decision criteria
- Apply the local-capacity test to model artefacts
- Qualify model substitutability with model-specific dependencies and revalidation needs
- Note volume-linked external pricing and deprecation risk under sustainability
- Address what countries receive in return when population health data is used for model development
